feeds.title: Vegan Style Blog
feeds.description: Born in Melbourne in 2010, Vegan Style was founded with a passion to bring people stylish footwear and accessories, without compromising animal welfare, ethical production, or environmental sustainability. The mission is to provide beautiful vegan fashion to the ethical consumer. To demonstrate that cruelty-free fashion can be stylish and attractive.

feeds.title: Rainbow Nourishments
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Anthea, and welcome to Rainbow Nourishments! I love talking about food and get really excited about ice cream. I created Rainbow Nourishments in 2014 to meet like-minded people and to share my love of food. All the recipes I create for Rainbow Nourishments are vegan as I believe it's more sustainable for the world and minimizes harm to animals.

feeds.title: Plant Based Folk
feeds.description: Heya, I'm Janelle! A messy but delicious cook. I've been creating vegan meals for a couple of years now. On my blog, you'll find vegan Lebanese recipes, breakfast, lunch, dinner, dessert, and more. All recipes listed are plant-based. The aim of all my cooking is to illustrate how easily you can cook a showstopping meal at home.

feeds.title: My Goodness Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Amanda, a cook, author, photographer, mum, wife, and animal advocate. I take classic and much-loved dishes and create plant-based versions and you can browse those simple, budget-friendly recipes to make your life easier on my blog. My Goodness Kitchen is your guide to cooking easy and delicious vegan meals, perfect for everyday cooking.

feeds.title: The Vegan Italian Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to your vegan Italian inspiration. I'm Nadia, a cookbook author, and vegan Italian recipe creator. I want to help you embrace life the Italian way through delicious recipes and the joy of cooking. If you're missing all of those Italian classics, I have the vegan versions for you.

feeds.title: That Vegan Dad Blog
feeds.description: I'm Jack. I am a father and husband and I have been vegan since 2017. My idea behind That Vegan Dad is to show everyone that adopting a vegan lifestyle can be easy and highly accessible for just about anyone! I update with weekly vegan taste test reviews, grocery hauls and plenty of tips and tricks to assist vegans.

feeds.title: Like a Vegan
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Chelsey and welcome to Like A Vegan, a lifestyle blog dedicated to showing you how to eat, look, travel, and live Like Vegan. Established in 2010 as a way to share recipes and tips with friends, Like A Vegan has evolved into a hub for vegans and the vegan-curious around the world, with a fun and light-hearted approach to veganism.

feeds.title: The Minimalist Vegan
feeds.description: We're Michael and Masa! Minimalist Vegan is a resource to bring you delicious vegan recipes using approachable everyday ingredients. We publish recipes, lifestyle articles, cooking videos, and host a podcast to help you live with less stuff and more compassion.

feeds.title: Cook Republic » Vegan
feeds.description: The Cook Republic dedicates the following section to vegan recipes. I am Sneh and I live in gorgeous Sydney in Australia. I am a food/lifestyle photographer, cookbook author, and stylist. The food on the Cook Republic doesn't limit itself to a set group or ethnicity, it is exciting and adventurous and packed with variety.

feeds.title: Passionately Keren Blog
feeds.description: I share delicious vegan recipes & and lifestyle tips for busy people to help them eat more plants and live a more joyful, inspired, passionate life. Welcome to my blog.

feeds.title: Buy Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Looking for plant-based or vegan products in Australia. We provide Australia's vegan food, fashion, and fitness directory on our blog. Buy Vegan is a directory of the best vegan products that you can find and buy in Australia. It started with our founder, Josh, and his partner Michaela, adding in their favorite vegan products. From there, friendly vegans and vegan friends have added their own favorite plant-based products to the directory.

feeds.title: Feel the Lean Blog
feeds.description: HI! I'm Loni Jane. I am 31 years young with two healthy plant-powered kids. My passions are being a focused mother, Earth-loving foods, respect for the world around me, and I believe in a sustainable lifestyle without fad diets, quick fixes, calorie restriction, or excessive exercise. Plant-based living has a ripple effect in a good way!

feeds.title: Elsa's Wholesome Life Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ellie, or as most may know me, Elsa! I am a 25-year-old nutritionist and dietitian from Australia. I follow a plant-based whole food diet and share colorful healthy food recipes to inspire you all to eat more plants!

feeds.title: Veggieful
feeds.description: My name is Maddie and we are excited to have you here. Our goal is to share yummy recipes, helpful resources, and our gentle plant-filled lifestyle. Here you will find easy and delicious recipes, accidentally vegan lists, FAQ, information, and everything to do with vegan families, kids, and babies.

feeds.title: Vegan Australia
feeds.description: Read the latest news from Vegan Australia plus vegan and animal rights news from around Australia and the world. Vegan Australia is an organization that campaigns nationally for veganism. We aim to educate Australians about veganism, animal rights, and the benefits of vegan living to human health, the natural environment, and social justice. We also research the best ways to educate people and raise awareness about these issues.

feeds.title: Simply Healthy Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Hi, Welcome to Simply Healthy Vegan! My name is Emily, I am the girl behind all these delicious healthy, whole foods plant-based recipes and food styling. If you are looking for some delicious vegan recipes, then you have come to the right place! You will find plenty of healthy yet tasty meal ideas which are all 100% Plant-based.

feeds.title: The Vegan Box
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Lorraine and my partner Phil and I are very excited to be a part of your Vegan journey whatever stage of it you are on! My mission is to celebrate the vegan lifestyle, regardless of how you live it, by bringing you every month the best new and exciting cruelty-free products as they hit the Australian market, even before if possible!

feeds.title: World Vegan Guides Blog
feeds.description: Need to know where to find the best vegan chocolates? Want a preview of the latest vegan-friendly skincare products? Or maybe you just want to check in with the latest recommendations we have. Get all this and more with our regular blog full of foodie reviews and tips and tricks of the trade. World wide vegan guide is a resource for all those interested in sourcing the best foodie spots in your city.
